about.description: GOOGL is a single-stock perpetual listed on Phemex, tracking Alphabet Inc., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 4h. Up to 10x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
